Data Engineer | Cloud & Integration

I build and operate enterprise-scale data platforms on Microsoft Azure: ETL/ELT pipelines, API-led integrations between business-critical systems, and the observability that keeps them dependable in production.

Profile

I am a Data Engineer. I have been designing, deploying and optimising enterprise data ecosystems on Microsoft Azure since 2024, and working in engineering roles since 2022: building end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines with Talend and MuleSoft, and instrumenting them with Datadog.

My work sits where integration meets operations: the pipelines I ship, I also run. That is deliberate: integration work is judged on what happens at 3 a.m., so error handling, alerting, recovery plans and written architecture documentation are part of the deliverable rather than follow-up.

I am seeking a full-time Data Engineering role to apply this expertise and continue growing professionally.
